ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AD \perp BC$ at $D$, $AE$ bisects $\angle DAC$, $\angle BAC = 80^\circ$, $\angle B = 60^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle DAE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: In $\triangle ABC$, since $\angle BAC + \angle B + \angle C = 180^\circ$,\\
then $\angle C = 180^\circ - 80^\circ - 60^\circ = 40^\circ$,\\
since $AD \perp BC$ at D,\\
then $\angle ADC = 90^\circ$,\\
in $\triangle ADC$, $\angle DAC = 90^\circ - \angle C = 90^\circ - 40^\circ = 50^\circ$,\\
since $AE$ bisects $\angle DAC$,\\
then $\angle DAE = \frac{1}{2} \angle DAC = \boxed{25^\circ}$
